channel.title: mint - technology
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Deepinder Goyal’s Temple brain wearable: ₹85,000 price, pre-order date and features
item.description: Deepinder Goyal’s Temple brain-monitoring wearable is reportedly priced at ₹85,000, including a lifetime subscription, with pre-orders opening on November 1, 2026. The device tracks changes in cerebral blood flow and generates an Entropy score to indicate physiological strain.

item.title: Tech Layoffs 2026: Job cuts near 2 lakh globally as big tech like Microsoft, Google, Oracle, Meta & more pivot to AI
item.description: Tech companies are utilising job cuts to demonstrate a commitment to margin expansion, pushing stock prices higher even as they announce internal restructuring.

item.title: Less than 20 folds, one cracked screen: iPhone Duo buyers raise durability concerns
item.description: Apple iPhone Duo buyers have reported cracked inner screens near the hinge within hours of use, with one user claiming the display broke after fewer than 20 folds. Images shared on Reddit reportedly show similar damage across multiple devices, raising concerns about the foldable phone’s durability.

item.title: Oppo ColorOS 17 beta update rolls out early to OnePlus 15, Find X9 series: New features and AI upgrades and more
item.description: Oppo has begun rolling out ColorOS 17 ahead of schedule to the OnePlus 15 and Find X9 series. The Android 17-based update brings redesigned animations, AI tools, performance improvements and new security features.

item.title: OnePlus Diwali Sale 2026: Nord 6, OnePlus 15, Nord CE6 Lite get discounts; check offers on phones, earbuds and tablets
item.description: OnePlus Diwali Sale 2026 offers discounts on smartphones, tablets and audio products. The OnePlus Nord 6 starts at ₹42,999 and OnePlus 15 at ₹81,999 with bank offers. Smartphone deals run until October 25, while tablet and audio offers end on October 27.

item.title: Forget iPhone Duo: Ashwini Vaishnaw sets October 2028 deadline for India’s own smartphone brand
item.description: Union IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw has set October 23, 2028, as the target for India to develop its own smartphones with domestic design, manufacturing and intellectual property.&nbsp;

item.title: Ever heard of a touchscreen garment? World's 1st is here - washable, breathable; it responds to finger presses, wireless
item.description: NUS researchers have developed a washable touchscreen sleeve that displays photos and videos, responds to touch, and measures body temperature. Made from electronic fibres, it retained its brightness and touch response after 50 machine washes.

item.title: Google Play System update latest Version download: How to check updates and fix the January 2027 date
item.description: Several Android phones, including the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, Google Pixel 8 Pro and Vivo X300 Ultra, are displaying an unexpected January 1, 2027 date for their Google Play System update.

item.title: Gone in 300 seconds! ₹3 lakh iPhone Duo foldable phone sells out on Blinkit; Is Apple's monthly lease worth it?
item.description: Apple’s first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, sold out on Blinkit within five minutes of going on sale in Delhi-NCR on October 23, 2026, with prices starting at ₹2,99,900 in India.&nbsp;

item.title: HMD 2660 Flip Senior Edition with AI Companion: What it offers specifically for senior citizens
item.description: AI companion Mary is available around the clock and can discuss topics such as history and nature, share stories, answer questions, play memory games or simply listen.

item.title: Vivo X500 series Europe launch on October 27: Expected camera specs, battery capacity and key features
item.description: The vivo X500 series is expected to focus on photography, video recording and AI-powered productivity.

item.title: Apple iPhone 17 Pro price drops to ₹72,050 on Flipkart with exchange and bank offers: Check how the deal works
item.description: Apple iPhone 17 Pro (256GB) is available at an effective price of ₹72,050 on Flipkart, against its listed price of ₹1,34,900. Buyers can get an exchange discount of ₹57,850 on an eligible iPhone 16 Pro, along with an additional ₹5,000 HDFC Bank discount.

item.title: Vivo Y600 with Guinness record-holding 10,000mAh battery to launch next week: Check date, design and expected specs
item.description: Vivo Y600 5G will launch in China on October 30, featuring a massive 10,000mAh battery and a design revealed in white and blue colour options. The smartphone reportedly achieved a Guinness World Records title after completing a continuous livestream test lasting 32 hours and 37 minutes.

item.title: Oppo Find X10 and X10 Pro Max launched in India: Triple 200MP cameras, 8,000 mAh battery, check price
item.description: Oppo has launched the Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max in India, featuring up to three 200MP rear cameras, batteries of up to 8,000mAh and AI-powered tools.

item.title: Polish PM Donald Tusk seeks deeper technology cooperation with India across AI, digital and space sectors
item.description: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has called for stronger technology partnerships between India and Poland, highlighting opportunities for companies from both countries across sectors including artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, digital products and space technology.

item.title: iPhone Duo shortage in India: Why buyers are paying up to ₹1 lakh extra for Apple's foldable
item.description: Apple’s first foldable, the iPhone Duo, is in short supply in India, with retailers reportedly charging ₹70,000 to ₹1 lakh over its ₹2,99,900 price. Retailers say they received only a handful of units, and Apple’s websites show 2027 delivery dates. Here’s what is behind the shortage.

item.title: Quantum computing could generate up to USD 2.7 trillion in economic value by 2035: McKinsey
item.description: Quantum computing could generate between USD 1.3 trillion and USD 2.7 trillion in economic value worldwide by 2035, but businesses need to invest in talent, technology and partnerships now to secure an early advantage, according to a report by McKinsey & Company.

item.title: Samsung brings 14 refurbished Galaxy S24, S25 smartphones to Amazon in US, prices start at $489
item.description: Samsung has expanded its Certified Re-Newed programme to Amazon.com, offering 14 refurbished Galaxy S24 and S25 models starting at $489. The phones feature genuine Samsung parts, new batteries, 147 quality checks and a one-year limited manufacturer warranty.

item.title: WhatsApp, Telegram SIM binding rules from January 1, 2027: Who will be affected in India?
item.description: WhatsApp, Telegram and other messaging apps may have to remain linked to registered, active SIM cards under India's new SIM-binding rules from January 1, 2027. The DoT has set December 31, 2026, as the compliance deadline, aiming to curb cyber fraud and the misuse of Indian mobile numbers.

item.title: Little-known eMudhra set the internet on red alert. What really happened?
item.description: India’s only certificate issuer trusted by browsers worldwide, eMudhra, is under scrutiny after a researcher found weak security keys in its website certificates. The company calls it a technical flaw, not a breach.

item.title: Explained: What is PHP? Why govt websites went dark? International advisory issued as AI exposes serious cyber glitch
item.description: PHP has triggered international advisories and forced websites offline worldwide, marking a new phase in cybersecurity in which increasingly powerful AI can uncover software vulnerabilities that humans have missed for years.

item.title: Redmi K100 launch date, camera and battery confirmed: What to expect from Xiaomi’s new smartphone
item.description: Redmi has confirmed the K100 will launch in China on October 28, 2026, with a Snapdragon 8 Elite chip, 6.83-inch 165 Hz AMOLED display, 10,000 mAh battery and 50 MP main camera. Pre-orders are open. Here’s what is known about the specs, design, Pro model differences and price.

item.title: Flexible grid connections can cut AI data centre power wait to 2-4 years from 5-10 years: BCG
item.description: Data centres supporting artificial intelligence (AI) could reduce their electricity connection waiting time from 5-10 years or more to 2-4 years by accepting flexible grid connections and using their own power generation and storage systems, according to a report by Boston Consulting Group (BCG).

item.title: Indias AI financing demand to shift towards data centres, but GPU, regulatory risks persist: Report
item.description: India’s AI market is expected to see a shift in demand towards debt financing for data centres and computing infrastructure. At the same time, the sector faces several risks, including the rapid obsoleteness of graphics processing units (GPUs), uncertain revenue models and evolving governance regulations, as per a report by Union Bank of India.

item.title: Vivo X500 Ultra tipped to get a larger 200MP telephoto sensor than X300 Ultra
item.description: Vivo X500 Ultra is tipped to feature a 200MP telephoto camera with a larger 1/1.2-inch sensor, potentially improving low-light photography over the X300 Ultra. The upcoming flagship could pack a Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, an 8,000mAh battery and a 6.85-inch LTPO AMOLED display.

item.title: In absence of sovereign buyers, Indian chip firms find clients in Japan, EU
item.description: Tata Electronics, Kaynes Semicon and CG Semi are pursuing overseas customers as domestic semiconductor demand remains limited, highlighting the gap between India’s chipmaking ambitions and commercial scale.

item.title: Telcos seek AI-led service quality monitoring, want rethink of traditional drive tests
item.description: The department of telecommunications (DoT) has planned setting up a joint committee to examine and simplify the existing service quality framework.&nbsp;

item.title: eMudhra security incident: MeitY orders probe, says impact on Indian websites and apps was limited; details here
item.description: MeitY has ordered a probe into the eMudhra security incident involving eight compromised digital certificates. The ministry said the impact on Indian websites and apps was limited and clarified that domestic digital signature services were not affected.

item.title: eMudhra intermediate CA certificates compromised: What happened, who is affected and what users need to know | Explained
item.description: CERT-In has warned that eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates were compromised due to weak cryptographic keys. Here's how fraudulent certificates could threaten encrypted communications and what users and website administrators should do.

item.title: Elon Musk's X to pay creators ₹2.85 lakh for 15 videos in 30 days: Check eligibility, rules and deadline to enrol
item.description: X is piloting an invite-only Video Kickstart Bonus that pays eligible creators a fixed $3,000 for regularly posting original videos. Details of the programme here.&nbsp;

item.title: iPhone 17 Pro 256GB gets a big discount: How to buy it at ₹56,990 on Reliance Digital? Check eligibility and more
item.description: Reliance Digital advertises the 256GB iPhone 17 Pro at an effective ₹56,990, down from its ₹1,34,900 launch price. The offer combines an in-store discount, eligible smartphone exchange value and bonus, and qualifying bank cashback; it is not a flat discount for all buyers.
